newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banc One Corp ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banc One Corp ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Tuesday it affirmed Banc One Corp's long-term rating at AA minus and short-term rating at A1 plus.
The affirmation follows the bank's announcement of the acquisition of First USA, a Texas-based company specialising in the credit card business, IBCA said in a statement.

"Banc One has long had a goal of being a nationwide provider of consumer services, but its credit card operations have generally been mediocre," IBCA said. "On the other hand, First USA has used technology and marketing expertise to substantially build market share in recent years."

"As a result of this transaction, Banc One will become the third largest credit card issuer in the U.S. and substantially improve its position in a profitable industry which has been consolidating," the rating agency said.
Although Banc One was paying a substantial premium for First USA, IBCA said the transaction made good strategic sense and should not hurt Banc One's finanacial position.
